articles.headline: Clark scores 17 and Luis makes his LSU debut as No. 25 Tigers top Louisiana-Monroe 79-67
articles.description: — Skyy Clark scored 17 points and RJ Luis Jr. had 11 points and nine rebounds in his LSU debut as the No. 25 Tigers pulled away late to defeat Louisiana-Monroe 79-67 on Wednesday night.
